content.short: Rho is a US business finance platform with banking, corporate cards, treasury and accounts-payable automation.
content.description: Rho is a US business finance platform that combines banking, corporate cards and spend management for startups and scale-ups. It offers business checking accounts, treasury products that put idle cash into money-market funds and Treasuries, corporate cards with no personal guarantee, accounts payable and bill pay, expense management and accounting integrations. Rho targets founders and finance teams who want to run banking, payments and cash management from one integrated platform rather than stitching together separate tools. By pairing accounts and cards with automated AP and treasury, it generates a connected stream of financial data where approvals, categorization and reconciliation are built into everyday operations.
content.meta: Rho offers business banking, corporate cards, AP and treasury in one platform. Discover Rho and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
